notes.title: Home Sailing - 1.1 release has shipped!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/2cb1767847499eee8e1132796b11200ef672f48b.gif[/img]

[h1]Ahoy![/h1] 
VR Regatta 1.1 has shipped! 

With this release VR Regatta is also [b]available on Oculus Home[/b].. and this means more sailors to interact with in Multiplayer ( which is cross-platform! :-) ) and compete in Daily Races.

[h1]Discover sailing[/h1]
Interested in learning how to sail? Never sailed before? Watch these first timers sail in VR Regatta:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LtrzRH6XZ60
[h1]Easter eggs[/h1]
What easter eggs in VR Regatta have you found? Here is [url=https://twitter.com/MarineVerseVR/status/1040151781370519553]one to give you an example[/url] :-)
[h1]Speedruns [/h1]
How quickly can your progress from Landsman to Able Seaman? Watch Greg completing this challenge: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=okk1LSIrHpo
Post your runs here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/1743346190280040174/

[h1]Happy sailing[/h1]
Remember to join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/H5Kxxcf 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/bc112073cbcd37d6d94da31ea6c4279ee14962ea.gif[/img]
Thank you for being part of VR Regatta community! 

Greg

notes.title: Smooth sailing - 1.1beta patch notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/57da4c459fe89f1842dde1b52d974e1efa2599bc.gif[/img]
Ahoy!

VR Regatta 1.1beta has just shipped with some major engine improvements and bug fixes!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] [b]Performance optimizations[/b] - We've optimized the game in various places and overall it should run much smoother.
    [*] Fixed minor issues with 3D text in levels 
    [*] Ability to setup private [url=https://www.marineverse.com/vr-regatta/events/test-event]"Daily Race" for events[/url] ( contact us ahoy@marineverse.com for more details )
    [*] Made "Fastest" quality water infinite
    [*] Added Oculus controller models in the multiplayer 
    [*] [b]Game engine update[/b] ( Unity ) - This is actually a big change, if you notice any issues, please let us know on the forum
[/list]

[i]This is a beta update in preparation for cross-play with Oculus Home. Proper 1.1 is expected with future Oculus Home release. If you want, you can opt-in into stable_1_0 branch if you prefer to stay on the old version.[/i]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l7KtnxppP_U
If you experience any problems or issues with the update, please let us know on the forum and we will try to fix: https://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/1/

Best regards,
MarineVerse team

notes.title: Get out onto the water today with VR Regatta, full version out now! 🍾⛵🎆
notes.notes:
Great news, virtual sailing fans!

After more than a year in early access, [i]VR Regatta: The Sailing Game[/i] officially launches today. Get that champagne bottle ready to smash on the bow* because this baby is seaworthy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/7b89bdd87b460ada6ef9221ac2a1385a6f3efadd.png[/img]

We’ve had a great time consulting with our faithful early adopters, implementing their feedback and adding in new features. The official version 1.0 release that has launched on Steam today had a bunch of cool new features. These include a new boat, a cute-and-simple Opti that brings the total in-game boats to three, and a whole new area to explore, the scorching hot equatorial region The Windy Islands.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/bc112073cbcd37d6d94da31ea6c4279ee14962ea.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/233086d83c3c0c309a753619308b7882c415bc00.jpg[/img]

If you’ve already bought VR Regatta then all of this is already yours—just update your game to the latest version and you’ll be good to go. If you’ve been waiting for the official release before getting on board, then we have some excellent news: during the launch week, we’ll be offering a 15% discount! Instead of US$14.99, you can grab the game for just US$12.74.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/4bb11fe361056d12238b14df61b188f065bbb50b.jpg[/img]

As always, we are endlessly grateful to everyone who has supported us by buying during early access, reporting bugs, signing up to this mailing list, and helping to spread the word. We’re so proud of this game, and we’re looking forward to making it even better in the future.

Cheers from the team at MarineVerse!

Greg

[i]* Please don’t actually smash a bottle of champagne on your computer or VR headset. You’ll void your warranty and make everything very sticky.[/i]

notes.title: VR Regatta official v1.0 release coming in just two weeks!
notes.notes:
Hello fans of virtual sailing!

VR Regatta has been on a long journey, but we have a [b]big[/b] milestone coming up that we’re really excited to tell you about. The game’s early access period is about to come to an end, and we are about to officially release version 1.0 of [i]VR Regatta: The Sailing Game[/i]!

As early access players, you’ve been with us from the start. We can never thank you enough for your patience, enthusiasm, and feedback, and this game could never have been as good as it is without your help. As such, we wanted you to be among the first in the world to get this news. (We haven’t even told the press yet!).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/b3f76eefd2fe8291b396c334ab40e10cf52bddb4.png[/img]

So, when is this auspicious date? On [b]January 30th[/b] for players on the eastern side of Atlantic, or January 31st on the western side, v1.0 of VR Regatta will be released and all you early access players will be able to update your copies. (It’s a simultaneous worldwide release, so the date differences are just because of time zones!)

[i]But that’s not all![/i] No, we’re not giving you any steak knives, but v1.0 will add a wealth of new content, including a new training sailboat for beginners and veterans to enjoy, plus a whole new location to explore. This new area is still mostly under wraps, but we will say that it is in a completely different part of the world from Akalana, with a much hotter climate and a different sailing conditions. We call it The Windy Islands...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/bc112073cbcd37d6d94da31ea6c4279ee14962ea.gif[/img]

This is not the end of the road for VR Regatta by a long shot. It’s is a big milestone, certainly, but this is still a living game that we will continue working on well into the future. Thanks so much for sticking with us over the past year, and we hope you really love the new content!

The MarineVerse team

notes.title: Update 0.3 - Multiplayer!
notes.notes:
We have just shipped an update to VR Regatta! :-)

Changes:

[list]
    [*]Introduced multiplayer - You can sail with others. This is just a start, will improve it in the next release
    [*]Added simple sailing terms level, using VR Regatta boat
    [*]Extended menu system, so that we can fit more content
    [*]Added new experiment - sailing on the waves
[/list]

As always, please let us know how can we improve VR Regatta - feedback@marineverse.com
